questions.stem: What is the main job of a naval doctor on a ship?
choices: To teach students in a school
questions.solution: The main job of a naval doctor is to provide medical care, including giving medicines to patients, to ensure the health of the crew. Teaching students, flying airplanes, and running a shop are unrelated to the medical responsibilities of a doctor.

hi.stem: एक जहाज पर नौसेना के डॉक्टर का मुख्य कार्य क्या है?
choices: एक स्कूल में छात्रों को पढ़ाना
hi.solution: नौसेना के डॉक्टर का मुख्य कार्य चिकित्सा देखभाल प्रदान करना है, जिसमें रोगियों को दवाएं देना शामिल है, ताकि अंकुश के स्वास्थ्य का ध्यान रखा जा सके। छात्रों को पढ़ाना, हवाई जहाज उड़ाना और दुकान चलाना डॉक्टर की चिकित्सा जिम्मेदारियों से संबंधित नहीं हैं।
hi.critique: The translation is accurate, maintains the original meaning, and uses appropriate Hindi medical terminology.

mr.stem: जहाजावरील नौसेना डॉक्टरचे मुख्य काम काय आहे?
mr.solution: नौसैनिक डॉक्टरचे मुख्य काम रुग्णांना औषधे देऊन आरोग्याची देखभाल करणे आहे, जेणेकरून अंतर्गत कर्मचारी आरोग्याने राहतील. विद्यार्थ्यांना शिकवणे, विमान चालवणे आणि दुकान चालवणे ही डॉक्टरच्या चिकित्सकीय जबाबदाऱ्यांशी संबंधित नाहीत.
mr.critique: The translation is accurate, maintains the original meaning, and uses appropriate Marathi medical terminology.

questions.stem: Why did Wahida move with her grandmother to Rajouri?
questions.solution: Wahida moved with her grandmother to Rajouri so that she could continue her education. She wanted to complete her tenth class, which was not common in her village at the time. The other options are not directly related to why she moved.

questions.stem: If a naval doctor is responsible for keeping the ship healthy, what would happen if there was no doctor on the ship?
choices: The ship would not be able to travel
The ship would not have any medical equipment
Diseases could spread among the crew
questions.solution: If there was no doctor on the ship, diseases could spread among the crew. A naval doctor ensures that everyone stays fit and healthy, and prevents issues like garbage collecting and rats, which can cause diseases. The other options are not correct as they do not directly relate to the role of a doctor.
